text:
ryan: quick flag 10:302 saw p95 jumps on host for tiny requests. pprof points to host parse/tokenize + stream pack -> grpc_writev/sys_writev hotpath.

ryan: flame: https://perf.internal/pprof?run=3420001111. sample stack:
```
tokenize_short
  parse_headers
    pack_frames
      grpc_writev
        sys_writev
```

anya: did this start after last night's kernel affinity change that routes <128 token flows to micro kernels?

lee: reproduced with `shortbench --seq=28 --rps=500`. small batches + fragmented writes cause KV shard thrash.

lee: quick numbers:
```
batch_min=3 -> p95=52ms, kv_evictions/s=230, writev_calls/s=720
batch_min=12 -> p95=30ms, kv_evictions/s=16, writev_calls/s=190
```

sam: theory: tiny mini-batches + micro kernel selection disables frame coalescing path, so syscall storm and KV hot shards.

ryan: mitigation: small canary (5%) that raises short-seq batch_min to 8, enables proxy frame_coalesce for <256B, and prefers kernels with lower syscall footprints.

deploy-bot: @ryan scheduled canary deploy: service=host-ingress group=shortseq-mitigation percent=5

anya: add telemetry: per-shard kv_eviction_rate, batch_size_histogram, grpc_writev_count, parse_coalesce_ms. propagate trace-id header so we can join traces.

lee: I'll add a microspan around tokenize->pack_frames and emit parse_coalesce_ms + batch_reason tag. ETA 30m.

sam: I'll flip the proxy frame_coalesce flag on canary and watch writev counts. long-term: adaptive batch floor reacting to kv_eviction_rate.

ryan: action items: lee instrument metrics, anya add dashboards & trace header, sam enable canary flag. I'll monitor canary and report p95/throughput. Ping here for regressions.
